column1: # ui field batch 2: the font/graphics data classes (29 fields).
# Glyph: BitmapFont's .fnt parser reads the columns in order - x (d), y (e), width (b), height (c),
#   xoffset (h), yoffset (i), xadvance (j) - then derives right/bottom as d+b (f) and e+c (g) and
#   stores its own index (a); k is the per-character data table that getData/setData index as
#   [char >>> 9][char & 0x1FF]. Label.drawGlyph draws with the source rect (glyph.d, glyph.e, glyph.b,
#   glyph.c) and advances by glyph.j, which matches.
# TextMetrics: BitmapFont fills width (a), height (b) and line count (c) in measure()/measureWrapped().
# ScrollBarStyle: ScrollPane.draw paints the three parts in one pass - the up arrow with
#   a/b frames and c/d size, the track with e/f frames and g/h size (g is also getScrollBarWidth()),
#   the down arrow with i/j frames and k/l size - and getScrollBarHeight() enforces the minimum
#   upArrowHeight + downArrowHeight, which is exactly d + l.
# GlTexture: the constructor generates the GL name into b, binds it, loads the pixmap into the
#   libGDX Texture a and records its size in c (width) and d (height).
